name: 63501 · Kirksville, MO
findings: ZIP 63501 (Kirksville) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63501 (Kirksville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63501 (Kirksville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
